title: Commercial Brand Manager
description:
Commercial Brand Marketing Manager

Are you an experienced brand marketer with a passion for developing impactful campaigns and building strong brand presence? We're looking for a Brand Manager to join our marketing team and play a key role in shaping and delivering brand strategy across a portfolio of products and brands.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead high profile campaigns, manage key partnerships and suppliers, and influence brand performance across multiple marketing channels.

The Role

You'll oversee campaign execution from concept through to delivery, manage budgets and supplier relationships, and use performance insights to shape future marketing activity.

What You'll Be Doing

- Managing supplier, agency and ambassador relationships to maximise campaign performance
- Identifying new marketing opportunities and supporting brand growth initiatives
- Overseeing media planning and placement across advertising, sponsorship and events
- Managing campaign budgets and tracking performance against objectives
- Analysing campaign results and providing recommendations for future activity
- Leading annual reviews of marketing collateral and brand assets
- Working closely with internal stakeholders to ensure campaigns align with business objectives
- Supporting and attending events, sponsorship activations and promotional activities
- Managing customer communications in line with GDPR, FCA and regulatory requirements
- Line managing and developing junior marketing team members

Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience in a brand, campaign or marketing management role
- Strong campaign planning and project management skills
- Experience managing agencies, suppliers or commercial partnerships
- Ability to analyse campaign performance and interpret business data
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong commercial awareness and creative thinking
- High attention to detail and organisational skills
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Experience within financial services or a regulated industry
- Experience managing ambassador or sponsorship partnerships
- CIM qualification or equivalent marketing qualification
- Proven experience delivering brand and marketing campaigns within a commercial B2 B environment

title: Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Manchester, UK Full-time, in-person

Salary depending on experience, plus performance bonus

We are a community-driven technology platform for the promotional products industry, bringing together 2,300+ distributor members, brand partners and modern merch sellers.

At the heart of the business is our AI-first platform, built to make running a promotional products business faster and easier. From sourcing and live inventory to mock-ups, artwork and intelligent business tools, we are building technology around the way this industry actually works.

We are growing. And we need someone who understands how to turn that growth opportunity into something measurable.

What this role is

We are looking for an experienced growth and lifecycle marketer who knows how to make sure strong marketing reaches the right people, through the right channels, at the right moment.

You will own the machinery behind that.

That means understanding our audiences, segmenting them properly in HubSpot, building email and CRM journeys, distributing campaigns and using data to continually improve acquisition, activation, engagement and retention.

You will work closely with our Brand & Culture Strategist and content team, who own how we sound and the creative direction of our marketing.

They create the signal. You make sure it reaches the right people, and prove whether it worked.

Your non-negotiables

This role requires:
- 3+ years in growth, lifecycle or performance-led marketing, ideally within SaaS, a platform or marketplace business.
- Demonstrable, hands-on HubSpot experience, including lists, segmentation, workflows, email campaigns, lifecycle stages, automation and reporting.
- Strong email and CRM marketing experience, including audience segmentation, behavioural targeting, nurture journeys, testing and optimisation.
- Strong analytical ability, with experience using campaign performance, CRM data, funnels and customer behaviour to make decisions.
- Proven ownership of acquisition AND retention, with evidence of bringing people in, moving them towards conversion and keeping them engaged.

These are the foundations of the role.

What you would actually be doing

You will build the infrastructure and strategy for reaching our audiences properly.

You will own HubSpot as a marketing tool, creating meaningful audience segments, maintaining lifecycle logic, building automated journeys and making sure CRM data informs our marketing.

You will build and optimise email programmes around behaviour and decide how campaigns should be distributed across email, paid, organic, partner, event and community channels.

You will map the journey from first interaction through sign-up, activation, engagement, conversion and retention, identifying where people move forward and where we lose them.

You will measure what happens. Not just opens, clicks and impressions, but whether marketing changed behaviour.

And you will bring those findings back into the business: what worked, what didn't and what we should do differently next time.

The audiences you will be working with

Our audiences range from owner-operators and established distributors with sales teams to individual reps, suppliers and brand partners.

Different people. Different behaviours. Different reasons to care.

Your job is to understand those differences and make sure our marketing reflects them.

Because good marketing sent to the wrong person is still the wrong marketing.

Acquisition is only half the job

Getting someone through the door matters. What happens afterwards matters just as much.

For our platform, that means understanding the journey from discovery and sign-up through to first use, returning, exploring more of the platform and ultimately making it part of how they work.

For our wider community, it means understanding what keeps members engaged and where we can deepen that relationship.

How you work

You are naturally curious about the numbers behind the marketing. You want to know why one audience responded and another didn't, why people signed up but never came back and why one segment converts differently from another.

You are comfortable getting into HubSpot yourself to find out.

You test, learn and adjust rather than relying on assumptions, turning information into clear decisions about what happens next.

AI is part of how we work

Our platform is AI-first and we want our marketing function to work with the same mindset.

You should already be comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or equivalent, and be curious about how AI can make segmentation, analysis, research, automation and marketing operations smarter.

What the business is like

This is an established company with real infrastructure, industry relationships and a large existing community, backed by a listed group. But we are building quickly.

You will work closely with brand, content, product, technology, sales and our US team.

This is an in-person role because that proximity matters. Most of our members are in North America, so there will occasionally be later finishes to overlap with our US team and community, as well as opportunities to travel to industry events in the US and UK.

Alongside salary, the role includes a performance bonus linked to growth and engagement.

How to apply

Send us your CV.

We will be looking for evidence of hands-on HubSpot experience, email and CRM marketing, audience segmentation, analytical decision-making and measurable acquisition and retention results.

You do not need a particular degree or a perfectly linear career. You do need to be able to show us what you have actually done.

This role is based in Manchester and requires you to be Manchester-based and able to work from the office. Remote applications will not be considered.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship.

title: Head of AI/SEO
description:
Head of AI Visibility & AutomationAbout the Role

We're looking for a Head of AI Visibility & Automation to lead a brand-new capability at the intersection of SEO, AI search and marketing automation.

You'll own how a portfolio of client brands are discovered, understood and recommended across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, social search and online communities, while building the automated infrastructure that allows these strategies to scale.

You'll lead two specialist managers across AI/Search Visibility and Data & AI Automation, bringing the two disciplines together into one high-performing function.

What You'll Be Doing
- Own the AI visibility / "brand everywhere" strategy across search, AI assistants, social and community platforms.
- Develop GEO/AEO strategies to improve how brands are cited, recommended and represented by AI.
- Build measurement frameworks around AI citations, share of voice, traffic and brand search uplift.
- Lead the design and rollout of n 8n-based automations across research, auditing, outreach, competitor intelligence and content planning.
- Ensure AI and automation workflows integrate with BI, content, creative and web publishing systems.
- Set standards around automation reliability, data quality and human oversight.
- Lead, coach and develop the Search Everywhere Strategy Manager and Data & AI Automation Manager.
- Act as a senior internal advocate for emerging AI search opportunities, helping the organisation stay ahead of the market.

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience in SEO/search strategy, with strong understanding of how generative AI is changing search and discovery.
- Hands-on experience with GEO/AEO, AI Overviews, LLM answer engines or AI chatbot optimisation.
- Experience designing or overseeing marketing workflow automation, ideally with n 8n, Zapier or Make.
- Strong people leadership experience, ideally managing specialists across different disciplines.
- Experience working across a multi-brand organisation or agency environment.
- Comfortable operating strategically while still understanding workflow logic, tooling and automation.
- Experience with AI/LLM APIs, agentic tooling or connected data is highly desirable.
- Strong stakeholder management and the ability to champion new ideas and ways of working.

Why This Role?

This is a chance to take ownership of a genuinely emerging area of digital marketing and build a capability that will shape how brands are discovered in the AI era.

You'll have the seniority, autonomy and team around you to combine SEO, AI visibility and automation into a scalable proposition - rather than simply reacting to where search is heading.

title: Marketing Manager / 12 - 14 month contract.
description:
The best marketing roles don't just give you responsibility. They give you trust. The freedom to own projects, influence decisions and leave your fingerprints on the business. This is one of those opportunities.

The role

It's with a growing business in the property & lifestyle scene that's built an enviable reputation in its sector, both here in the UK and internationally.

This is hands-on & packed with variety. But what really stands out is the people. This isn't a business full of egos, endless meetings or layers of unnecessary process. Instead, you'll join a team of thoughtful, grounded and genuinely decent people who care about doing things properly.

This is the kind of role where no two weeks look quite the same. One morning, you might be launching a campaign, reviewing performance data and spotting new opportunities for growth. By the afternoon, you could be briefing an agency, creating content, coordinating an event or working with senior stakeholders on future plans.

You'll have ownership of the marketing calendar & the freedom to drive activity across a mix of channels. From digital campaigns and email marketing to content, events, CRM, and brand projects, you'll be at the heart of it all.

This isn't a role where you'll be asked to simply keep the wheels turning. We're looking for someone with a few years under their belt & enjoys bringing fresh ideas to the table, rolling up their sleeves, and making things happen.

Handy sector experience would be property or an adjacent one such as hospitality, travel or retail. You're organised without being rigid, creative without losing sight of commercial goals and confident enough to manage multiple moving parts at once.

You enjoy the mix that modern marketing brings. A bit of strategy. A bit of creativity. A bit of analysis. A bit of problem-solving. The business is full of approachable, considered individuals who value good relationships, clear communication and common sense. You'll fit right in if you're someone who leaves the ego at the door and gets stuck in.

Why join?

You'll inherit a role with real visibility, genuine ownership and plenty of support around you. You'll work alongside people who are ambitious without being corporate, driven without taking themselves too seriously and experienced enough to trust good people to do great work.

Add in a salary range of 45-50k, flexible working, healthcare benefits, generous holiday allowance, company events and an environment where marketing has a genuine seat at the table, and you've got a pretty compelling opportunity.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
The Role
We're looking for a commercially driven, forward-thinking Performance Marketing Manager to lead our paid media strategy for our Novasol brand.

Paid media is evolving faster than ever, and we need someone who understands the fundamentals but is constantly thinking about how to improve, innovate, and stay ahead of the curve - someone who brings a genuinely commercial mind, an inquisitive streak, and fluency in how AI is reshaping performance marketing.

You'll take ownership of our paid activity for Novasol, working within our wider performance team across core brands including Hoseasons, & James Villas. With responsibility for a significant budget and ambitious targets, you'll play a key role in driving high-quality customer acquisition in a highly competitive travel market.

You'll thrive in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on optimisation, and build strong collaborative relationships across teams including Revenue Management, Brand, SEO, Product and Analytics.

What You'll Be Doing
Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will:
- Own the end-to-end paid media strategy for the Novasol brand
- Lead day-to-day optimisation of campaigns, ensuring budgets are allocated effectively to maximise ROI and commercial performance
- Leverage automation, AI-driven solutions and new platform innovations to continuously improve performance
- Design and run a structured testing programme across structure, creative, landing pages, audience strategy and bidding models, applying sound measurement and incrementality frameworks to validate results
- Work closely with Revenue Management to align performance activity with pricing, occupancy and commercial priorities
- Manage the creative supply chain with Brand and Creative teams - briefing, production timelines and asset delivery - ensuring messaging and creative supports broader marketing objectives
- Partner with SEO and Product teams to improve landing page performance, conversion rates and overall customer journey
- Analyse and report on performance trends, surfacing risks and opportunities with clear, commercially-framed recommendations
- Monitor competitor activity and industry developments to ensure we remain ahead in an increasingly competitive PPC landscape
- Contribute to a culture of innovation within the performance team, championing new ideas, tools and ways of working
- Ultimately, you'll be accountable for delivering performance and ensuring paid channels continue to be a key driver of acquisition for Novasol.

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who combines strong paid media expertise with commercial acumen, curiosity, and a collaborative mindset.

Experience & Technical Skills
- Proven experience managing PPC campaigns at scale is essential (Search Ads 360 experience desirable)
- Strong commercial mindset and analytical skills - able to connect paid media performance to revenue, margin and business outcomes, not just channel metrics
- Solid grounding in measurement and testing frameworks - attribution, incrementality and structured test-and-learn methodology
- AI-literate, with hands-on experience using automation and AI-driven tools to improve paid media performance
- Experience managing a creative supply chain - briefing and working with creative teams or agencies to keep campaigns fresh and effective
- Experience managing paid social and programmatic activity desirable
- Experience managing significant budgets with clear accountability
- Experience within travel or another fast-paced, seasonal, commercially-driven industry is desirable

Behaviours & Mindset
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
- Highly collaborative - able to build strong relationships across Revenue, Brand, SEO, Product and Analytics teams
- Naturally inquisitive - comfortable questioning assumptions, testing hypotheses and exploring new platform and industry developments
- Commercially minded - understands how paid channels drive business outcomes, not just channel metrics
- Detail-oriented but able to think strategically

About Awaze

Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe's widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what's next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

Worth knowing

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager - Flow Student

Location: Manchester office-based, with travel across the Flow Student portfolio when required
Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 depending on experience
Reporting to: Head of Marketing
Department: Flow Student Marketing

About Flow Student:

We're already home to students across some of the UK's best university cities, including Liverpool, Sheffield, Coventry, Nottingham, Sunderland, Canterbury, Bradford and Preston. With major refurbishment projects continuing across the portfolio, we're upgrading our spaces and preparing them for students joining us.

Our proposition is straightforward: student living that flows around you.

Launched in late 2025, Flow Student is a brand-new brand and one of the UK's fastest-growing student accommodation providers, offering affordable, well-designed student accommodation across some of the UK's best university cities.

We're building a more distinctive, commercially effective student accommodation brand. Social media will be a huge part of how we build that brand, connect with students and turn attention into enquiries and bookings.

That's where you come in.

The Role:

We're looking for a Social Media Manager who understands that great social media is about much more than posting content.

You'll own the day-to-day social presence of Flow Student, developing content and communities that feel genuinely relevant to students and culturally in tune with the platforms they use.

You'll need to be deeply immersed in Gen Z trends, behaviours, language, creators, formats and online culture. You'll know what is gaining traction, understand why it works, and - importantly - know when a trend is right for Flow Student and when it isn't.

One day you might be developing a TikTok around a student-life trend. The next, you could be briefing a creator, filming content at one of our properties, responding to comments, analysing performance or turning a resident story into a piece of content that travels across Instagram and TikTok. A key part of this role will also be developing engaging content, aimed at generating enquiries, leads and ultimately sales.

You'll work closely with the marketing team, property teams, the design team and residents to make Flow Student a brand students recognise, engage with and want to be part of.

This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone who can spot the opportunity, create the content, publish it, engage the audience and understand the numbers behind it.

What you will be responsible for:
- Owning the Flow Student organic social media strategy across relevant platforms, with a particular focus on TikTok and Instagram.
- Developing and maintaining an engaging social media calendar aligned to brand, commercial and booking priorities.
- Creating, commissioning and publishing social-first content that feels native to each platform rather than repurposed advertising.
- Staying relentlessly close to Gen Z trends, online culture, creators, memes, formats, sounds and emerging behaviours, identifying opportunities for Flow Student.
- Turning trends into relevant Flow Student content quickly, while ensuring the brand remains authentic and recognisable.
- Developing recurring social formats, series and content pillars that build familiarity and engagement over time.
- Capturing content across our properties, including student life, facilities, events, local areas, room tours, resident experiences and behind-the-scenes moments.
- Working with residents and student creators to produce credible, relatable content about life at Flow Student.
- Supporting and developing the Flow Creators programme, helping residents become confident and effective brand advocates. Building relationships with creators and managing collaborations from brief through to delivery and reporting.
- Monitoring conversations, trends and competitor activity to understand what students are talking about and where Flow Student can participate meaningfully.
- Working closely with property teams to uncover local stories, student insights, events and content opportunities.
- Collaborating with designers, photographers, videographers and external agencies to produce high-quality social content.
- Supporting integrated campaigns across paid social, email, website and other marketing channels, ensuring social plays a meaningful role.
- Working with the wider marketing team to align social activity with key booking periods, including early booking, international recruitment, January intake, Clearing and late availability.
- Tracking engagement, reach, audience growth, content performance, enquiries and other relevant metrics.
- Producing concise reports and recommendations that turn social data into action.
- Managing social content calendars, deadlines, approvals and asset libraries so content reaches the audience at the right time.
- Occasionally preparing content for the corporate Linkedin page, relating to Flow Student news.

What success looks like:

We will look at whether:
- Flow Student has a distinctive, recognisable and engaging presence across its social channels.
- Our content feels genuinely relevant to students rather than like traditional accommodation advertising.
- Clear understanding of commercial performance.
- You consistently identify emerging Gen Z trends and turn the right ones into opportunities for the brand.
- Social content is delivered quickly, consistently and to a high standard.
- The Flow Student community is growing and becoming increasingly engaged.
- Residents and creators are producing credible content that students actually want to watch and share.
- Social activity contributes meaningfully to awareness, enquiries and ultimately bookings.
- You continually test, learn and improve rather than simply repeating what worked last time.
- You use performance data to make better creative and commercial decisions.
- You proactively identify opportunities rather than waiting to be told what to post.
- Flow Student
